title: Canonical student-item interaction
description: Normalized interaction used by the TCC prototype. The row represents the target event itself: item and skill context are known before the response, while outcome fields are revealed only after the prediction and may become historical evidence for later events.
$comment: In the primary protocol, the observed `correct` value on this target event is the modeling label named `correct_next` relative to the prior history. Outcome fields from this same event must not be used as predictors.

student_id.description: Anonymous or dataset-native public student identifier.

item_id.description: Target item identifier known before the response in the primary protocol.

skill_ids.description: One or more skills mapped to the target item and known before the response.

interaction_order.description: Stable within-student order used to define strictly prior history.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp when available. Ordering rules for ties must be deterministic and versioned.

correct.description: Observed outcome of the target interaction. It is unavailable at prediction time and becomes the `correct_next` label only after the response.

answer.description: Observed answer on the target event. It is not a predictor for that same event in the primary protocol.

attempt_count.description: Attempts observed for this event. The target-event value is excluded from primary predictors; prior-event values may contribute to historical features.

hint_count.description: Hints observed for this event. The target-event value is excluded from primary predictors; prior-event values may contribute to historical features.

elapsed_time_ms.description: Elapsed time observed for this event. The target-event value is excluded from primary predictors; prior-event values may contribute to historical features.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier when supplied by the source dataset.

source_dataset.description: Versioned dataset identifier used for provenance.

source_row_id.description: Stable source-record identifier used for traceability and duplicate detection.
